design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (d2_contract_pricing_claims_and_rebates): final rebate settlement of an early-terminated Corbett Strategic Supply Agreement.

1. Why this is a good test. Dana Eckhart (Fairhaven Gear & Machine, Inc.) asks only that the rebate still owed under the ended agreement CPA-20417 be paid by check. Paying the right check forces the agent to (a) read the final-check rule and see that the check "is not issued until the rebate ledger carries the forfeiture entry for the rebate period in which the termination took effect"; (b) read the forfeiture rule and see that the forfeiture "is fixed only after the rebate ledger carries a clawback entry for the customer's most recently received return whenever that return is of termination-period merchandise received after the termination period's accrual"; (c) find in the order records that RMA-208152 was received 2026-10-07, after the 2026-Q3 accrual of 2026-10-01, for a line shipped 2026-09-15, and that no reversal carries it; (d) work three multi-factor figures in topological order on the moving ledger. Difficulty comes from reading policy, querying four other products (order returns and shipments, credit account and ledger, StockSmart and VendPoint holdings) and arithmetic; there is one tool per problem and no near-synonym tools.
2. Scope (Principle C). Task 0 claims pricing_ext_final_rebate_check (root, owner=user), pricing_ext_termination_forfeiture and pricing_ext_return_clawback (both agent) and their three tools. Nothing was occupied before. Left for task 1 (4 problems): the claim side of the charter — pricing_ext_substitute_claim (user files a contract price claim), pricing_ext_substitute_protection, pricing_ext_discontinued_closeout and pricing_ext_open_claim_decision on pricing_claim_filed / pricing_item_added / pricing_item_removed / pricing_claim_decided — none of which task 0 touches.

3. Draw. draw_counts.py --task 0 -> prerequisite_problems 2, factor_counts [5, 6, 4]; assigned final_rebate_check 6, termination_forfeiture 5, return_clawback 4.

4. Problem-tree card. Chain: final_rebate_check -> termination_forfeiture -> return_clawback.
 Edge E1 final_rebate_check -> termination_forfeiture: kind value_input, gate bal (the ledger unpaid balance), form state, policy_source "On an agreement terminated early, the final rebate check is not issued until the rebate ledger carries the forfeiture entry for the rebate period in which the termination took effect." (negated direction: a release is "not issued until"). Four-point test: ordering connective "not ... until"; XX is a record-visible state (a forfeiture entry on the rebate ledger); names no tool/id/code; scope exactly "on an agreement terminated early" and the period the check rule itself names (round 2: no longer borrows "the termination period" from the forfeiture rule). Exactly one write of this difficulty books a forfeiture entry: book_termination_rebate_forfeiture_47cc59ce (the clawback tool writes RMA-referenced reversals, the check tool writes payouts). Derivation: sentence + ledger (no reversal with source CPA-20417) + the forfeiture rule (which books "the rebate forfeiture of an agreement whose status is terminated") -> the forfeiture write. False at the opening: pricing_agreements.status = terminated, closed_date 2026-09-30, the 2026-Q3 accrual exists (2026-10-01), no reversal carries CPA-20417, rebate_balance 18,957.75 (the whole 2026-Q3 accrual; every earlier period was paid). Resolved by the agent within the call. Deletion sensitivity: skipping step 15 makes the check 16,869.10 instead of 7,823.79.
 Edge E2 termination_forfeiture -> return_clawback: kind value_input, gate term_net, form state, policy_source "The forfeiture is fixed only after the rebate ledger carries a clawback entry for the customer's most recently received return whenever that return is of termination-period merchandise received after the termination period's accrual." (affirmative direction: a charge "is fixed only after"; round 2 aligned its quantifier with the clawback's single-return scope). Exactly one write books a clawback entry: book_rebate_return_clawback_ccd0c1e2. False at the opening: order_returns receipt of RMA-208152 dated 2026-10-07, its line SO-2125514/3 shipped 2026-09-15, accrual 2026-Q3 dated 2026-10-01, no pricing_rebates line with source_reference RMA-208152. Deletion sensitivity: skipping step 13 makes the forfeiture 9,952.82 instead of 9,939.90 (and the check then 7,834.42 instead of 7,823.79).
 Topological order: clawback (step 13) -> forfeiture (step 15) -> check (step 19). No parallel edges, so no free reordering. The owner=user problem is the root: the check request is Fairhaven's own payout instruction, run by Dana on the spot. No edge needs a post-call event: every resolving write is synchronous.
 user_scenario mentions no return, RMA, clawback or forfeiture; the tools validate nothing (they write whatever is passed).

5. Base-invariant card. pricing_rebate_reversed and pricing_rebate_paid are governed by pricing_evt_rebate only; its single gate one_accrual_per_period applies to pricing_rebate_accrued, so each write carries a policy_scope precondition. Overwrites (sentence-level, declared): the clawback retires "Where rebate_clawback_on_returns is true, a return credited after the period's rebate was accrued reduces the rebate by the returned merchandise value times the rate originally applied ..." for the one return it books (out-of-scope returns keep the base clause verbatim); the forfeiture retires "Where termination_rebate_forfeit is true, an early termination forfeits the whole unpaid rebate balance ..." for terminations inside the latest accrued period (completed periods stay on the ledger unforfeited; every other early termination keeps the base clause); the check retires "The rebate balance is paid within rebate_payout_days_after_period days ... a balance below rebate_min_payout_usd carries forward ..." for the final check (holdbacks stay on the balance; every other payout keeps the base clause). Termination time gate (pricing_renewal_and_termination.termination_notice_period) belongs to the already-completed termination: notice received 2026-02-17, effective 2026-09-30 = 225 days later, at least the tier's 180 (boundary case: a notice received 2026-04-03 would also have allowed 2026-09-30, one received 2026-04-04 would not). No time gate applies to the three gold writes.

6. Business-object card. Target: agreement CPA-20417 (one pricing_agreements row). Clawback object: RMA-208152, one receipt line on SO-2125514 line 3, excluded rows: RMA-204611 (already reversed 2026-04-21 against 2025-Q4 under the base clause), RMA-206208 and RMA-207415 (credited 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-21, inside 2026-Q3 and netted in its accrual), RMA-209344 (authorized only). Forfeiture object: period 2026-Q3 (latest accrual, termination effective the period's last day); 2026-Q2 (accrued 2026-07-01) was paid by check on 2026-07-28, inside its 30-day payout window. Check object: the agreement's unpaid balance after both reversals (the kept relief share of 2026-Q3), recorded against the latest accrued period 2026-Q3.

7. Factor cards (tier taken / evidence / baseline figure from the sensitivity run).
 Clawback (4): merchandise_value_basis [method; opened_unused -> qty 120 x invoiced 48.6200 = 5,834.40 instead of the return credit 4,084.08; baseline gives 17.23; the unrounded product is used, rounding only the final figure]; return_reason_share [parameter; ordered_in_error -> 0.75; baseline 32.82]; credit_size_share [parameter; credit 4,084.08 in [500, 5,000) -> 0.5; baseline 49.23]; return_frequency_share [parameter, history; 4 receipt lines in 12 whole months -> 0.75; baseline 32.82]. All four cross-difficulty (order). Whole baseline 61.26. Near-miss: RMA-209344 dated later than RMA-208152 but only authorized; RMA-207415 is a receipt but before the accrual.
 Forfeiture (5): commitment_attainment_relief [method; accrual spend 5,099,500.00 / 3,000,000.00 = 1.6998 -> fixed 0.3 share (shapes: fixed share for >= 1.5, sliding (attainment-1) x 0.6 for [1, 1.5), none below; the two shares meet only at 1.5, which belongs to the fixed tier, so they never coincide on their domains); baseline 15,619.84]; tenure_relief_share [29 whole months -> 0.05; baseline 10,886.56]; extra_notice_relief [45 extra days -> 0.025; baseline 10,413.23]; kept_program_relief [multi-source, cross-difficulty vmi+vending: active StockSmart VMI-20533, VendPoint VP-208114 removed -> one of the two -> 0.05; baseline 10,886.56]; period_alignment_relief [effective on the period's last day -> 0.05; baseline 10,886.56]. Whole baseline 18,933.14 (the termination period net rebate).
 Check (6): returns_reserve_holdback [multi-source, order: 3 receipt lines and 7,562.88 credit in 3 whole months -> 4 percent; baseline 8,183.52]; credit_exposure_holdback [credit: 839,699.52 / 1,000,000.00 = 0.8397 -> 2.5 percent; baseline 8,048.62]; payment_terms_holdback [credit ledger: 2 finance charges in 12 whole months -> 1.5 percent; baseline 7,958.69]; unexpired_term_administration [method: 6 whole months left -> flat 350.00 (shapes: flat, 50.00 per remaining month for 1-5 months, none; per-month reaches at most 250.00 so never equals the flat); baseline 8,173.79]; open_authorization_holdback [order: RMA-209344 unsettled, no_longer_needed -> 30 x 22.3600 x 1.50 / 100 = 10.06; baseline 7,833.85]; returned_payment_holdback [credit ledger: 1 returned payment -> 1 percent; baseline 7,913.72]. Whole baseline 8,993.24.
 Every declared factor sits off its fall-through; no stamp field is read (status values are lifecycle states, tiers come from ledgers and dates).
8. initial_state rows and why each exists. customers (identity: account C-204318, ZIP 45215 used for verification); credit_accounts (Net 60 Corporate, active, limit 1,000,000.00, receivable 839,699.52 = open August and September invoices less their return credits: exposure tier); credit_transactions (13 monthly consolidated invoices 2025-09..2026-09, their payments, two finance charges FC-2251231 214.80 on the 21,480.00 short payment of the September 2025 invoice (paid 2026-01-08, 39 days past due, under the 45-day hold trigger) and FC-2260531 94.05 on the February 2026 short payment, the returned check RTN-2260302 (the check that had paid FC-2251231) with its 25.00 fee and wire re-payment, four return credit memos; the receivable never exceeds the 1,000,000.00 limit (peak 890,834.80 on 2025-12-31, two monthly invoices open plus a short-paid remainder), so no over-limit hold arises and shipments on terms continue; no cash discount because a Strategic Supply Agreement is an excluded pricing tier: terms, returned-payment and exposure tiers); ship_to_accounts (Premier Route ship-to, parent of every order row; restocking 10 percent, opened-item credit 80 percent, route pickup free); order_lines (booking and shipment of the five returned lines); order_returns (four RMAs authorized and received plus RMA-209344 authorized only); pricing_agreements (the terminated agreement, its dates and commitment); pricing_rebates (ten accruals 2024-Q2..2026-Q3, nine check payouts 2024-Q2..2026-Q2 each inside the 30-day payout window, one base-clause clawback: balance 18,957.75 = the 2026-Q3 accrual, the latest accrual, attainment spend); vmi_programs (active StockSmart Monthly Service VMI-20533, live 2023-05-19, 13 business days after enrollment, inside the tier's 15: program relief) with vmi_bins (76 bins, the tier gate's 75 met) and vmi_activity (one scheduled visit a month, 2025-09..2026-09, three bins replenished at Strategic category-discount prices, billed 2,055-2,102 a month, above the 2,000.00 minimum spend, so no minimum fee is due; billed on the monthly consolidated invoice); vending_machines (removed Coil 40: one-program tier) with vending_transactions (monthly usage bills 2025-09..2025-11 of 1,318-1,486, above the 1,250.00 minimum, billed on the consolidated invoices; none after removal). Automatic-clause check: one accrual per period through 2026-Q3 (the agreement ended with Q3); every payout before 2026-Q3 was made inside its window (2026-Q2 on 2026-07-28), and 2026-Q3's own payout window runs to 2026-10-30, so nothing is overdue; the forfeiture owed since the 2026-10-01 accrual is carried by step 15, the clawback owed since 2026-10-07 by step 13; the credit account has no past-due balance at 2026-10-16 (August invoice due 2026-10-30), so no hold, finance charge or collections obligation is open; the returned-payment count (1) is below the Corporate hold count (3); certified-funds months after the return were paid by wire; StockSmart and the removed VendPoint machine carry no open obligation. Cache: pricing_agreements.rebate_balance equals the ledger (18,957.75); the final check recomputes the balance from the ledger, so no cache trap is used.
9. Persona design. Dana is a terse, organised controller closing a contract; she volunteers only facts the seed entails (notice in February: 2026-02-17; ended September 30th: closed_date; last check for the second quarter in July: payout 2026-07-28; the third quarter's rebate not come yet: 2026-Q3 accrued, unpaid, its window still open). Identity and the agreement number are given only when asked; she cannot answer about returns and defers to Corbett's records. Passive reactions: she accepts the amount the agent states (round 2: the line no longer pre-states a forfeiture or holdback explanation); she runs the check request herself when handed the tool with reference, period and amount; she reads back the payout reference and ends. She never mentions any prerequisite and never names an amount. Her only ask is the check payout.
10. Standard solution (handling-time recomputation executed with the gate's own evaluator, t0_vals.py). Steps 0-11 read: customer, verification (account number + ZIP), agreement, rebate ledger, order returns, ship-to, order lines, StockSmart programs, VendPoint machines, StockSmart bins and activity, VendPoint transactions. Step 13 clawback: 5,834.40 x 1.50 / 100 x 0.75 x 0.5 x 0.75 = 24.6139, unrounded until the final figure -> 24.61 (balance 18,957.75 -> 18,933.14). Step 15 forfeiture on term_net 18,933.14: reliefs 5,679.94 + 946.66 + 473.33 + 946.66 + 946.66 = 8,993.24 -> 9,939.90 (balance -> 8,993.24). Steps 16-17 read the credit account and ledger. Step 19 check: 8,993.24 - (359.73 + 224.83 + 134.90 + 350.00 + 10.06 + 89.93 = 1,169.45) = 7,823.79 >= 100.00 -> issued (balance -> 1,169.45 held back). Whole-month counts use the rule's stated convention (calendar months less one when the later day of the month is earlier): tenure 29, months left 6. check_compute recomputes every value at handling time and every factor_sensitivity figure.
11. Easy mistakes and how the policy excludes them. Paying 18,957.75 (no forfeiture, no clawback, no holdbacks); forfeiting the whole balance (the extended forfeiture keeps the relief share); clawing back RMA-209344 (authorized only) or RMA-207415 (credited inside Q3); using the return credit instead of the opened-item merchandise value; rounding the clawback before the shares (the rule rounds only the final figure); counting tenure as 30 months (the rule states the whole-month convention: 29); counting ledger lines 12 months and more back; reading the cached balance before the reversals; booking the forfeiture before the clawback (9,952.82); requesting the check before the forfeiture (16,869.10).
12. Policy/GT closure. pricing_ext_return_clawback -> book_rebate_return_clawback_ccd0c1e2 -> computations[0] step 13 amount 24.61 -> reversal line RMA-208152; pricing_ext_termination_forfeiture -> book_termination_rebate_forfeiture_47cc59ce -> computations[1] step 15 amount 9,939.90 -> reversal line CPA-20417; pricing_ext_final_rebate_check -> request_final_rebate_check_d4aa8dfe -> computations[2] step 19 amount 7,823.79 -> payout line (check). charter_scope = required_documents = the three policies; task_tools in order of first call.
13. Draft recomputation from the visible context (compute/GT masked): from the KB rules as published (scope, baseline, factor ladders, prerequisite sentences), the tool schemas and the find_* returns, the order clawback -> forfeiture -> check is forced by the two prerequisite sentences; every tier is read off the returned rows; the figures agree with gold (24.61 / 9,939.90 / 7,823.79).

14. Gate runs (per task): check_extended, check_task_tools, replay_tasks, check_solvability, check_compute, check_grounding, check_cross_fire all OK; check_cache_diff INFO only. Revisions: (r1) history floor failed for clawback and check (only LATEST/X-reads of this holding) -> added the period cap (SUM) to the clawback and recomputed the check's balance from the ledger; (r2) two factors read no record of their own -> the size share now reads the credit itself and the alignment relief reads its own date gap; (r3) unit prices re-derived from list less the Strategic category discount (bearings 15, cutting tools 22, abrasives 22, electrical 14 percent) and the on-account return credit drawn by the next payment -> all figures recomputed (round-1 world: clawback 24.61, forfeiture 9,939.90, check 25,017.33, superseded by the round-2 seed change below); (r4) forfeiture net rebate also subtracts payouts on the termination period (probe: a payout on 2026-Q3 must not be forfeited twice).

 Round 2 rework (audit revision_1): T0-1/CG-4 the clawback rule now computes the unrounded product, applies shares, then the cap, the 0.00 floor and one rounding (stated in the baseline and the assembly sentence; same for every policy); T0-2/CG-5 every rule states the whole-month convention (calendar months less one when the later day is earlier), the calendar-day convention and the same-date tie rule; O-4 the check's prerequisite sentence names its own period; forfeiture's prerequisite quantifier aligned with the clawback's single-return scope; T0-O1 persona no longer pre-states forfeiture/holdback acceptance; T0-O2 the 2026-Q2 rebate was paid on 2026-07-28, so no payout lapse remains in the seed. Figures after the change: clawback 24.61, forfeiture 9,939.90, check 7,823.79.
 Round 4 rework (KB-VERDICT revision_2 src items): SRC-2 the credit ledger is now one the credit rules produce with the seeded 1,000,000.00 limit — the late September 2025 payment is a 21,480.00 short payment (finance charge 214.80), the returned check is the one that paid that finance charge, and the receivable peaks at 890,834.80, inside limit plus tolerance; no hold, shipments continue; the exposure share at the call (839,699.52 / 1,000,000.00) and every scored figure are unchanged. SRC-3a StockSmart VMI-20533 is a Monthly Service program live 2023-05-19 (13 business days); O-3 its bins, monthly visits, deliveries and billing are seeded and keep it above its minimum, and the VendPoint machine's usage bills through its removal month are seeded.
user_scenario:
You are Dana Eckhart, controller at Fairhaven Gear & Machine, Inc., a gear and machining shop near Cincinnati. You are calm, organised and a little impatient with paperwork that drags on; you speak in short, businesslike sentences. You are calling Corbett Industrial Supply about the company's old Strategic Supply Agreement. Fairhaven gave written notice in February to end it early, and it ended on September 30th. You are closing the books on that contract, and the last rebate check Fairhaven received under it was the one for the second quarter, in July; the third quarter's rebate has not come yet. What you want is simple: whatever rebate Fairhaven is still owed under that agreement, paid out by check. You do not want it left as a credit on the account, and you would like the check request put in today, on this call.
When the agent wants to confirm who you are, you give the account number C-204318 and the billing ZIP code 45215. Only if the agent asks for something more, you can also give the main phone number 5133271904, the email d.eckhart@fairhavengear.com or the last four digits of the company's EIN, 2471. If the agent asks which agreement, you say it is the agreement number printed on the contract, CPA-20417. You do not know the rebate figures, the rates, or what is on Corbett's ledger; you leave that to the agent and do not guess at amounts. You do not track individual returns or RMAs yourself; if the agent asks about returns, you say the plant sends things back now and then and Corbett's own records will show whatever was returned.
You leave Corbett's own bookkeeping to the agent. Once the agent tells you how much the check will be, you accept the figure as the agent states it; you may say it is less than you hoped, but you do not argue with the contract. The check request itself is Fairhaven's own instruction: when the agent hands you the step to request the check, with the agreement reference, the rebate period and the amount, you run it yourself exactly as given. When the request goes through, you read back the check payout reference it gives you, thank the agent and end the call.

edges.condition: The agreement's rebate ledger carries a reversal line whose source reference is the agreement number, booked against the rebate period in which the termination took effect.
edges.policy_source: On an agreement terminated early, the final rebate check is not issued until the rebate ledger carries the forfeiture entry for the rebate period in which the termination took effect.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The agreement terminated early on 2026-09-30 and 2026-Q3, the rebate period in which the termination took effect, has accrued (2026-10-01), yet the rebate ledger holds no reversal line carrying the agreement number CPA-20417; the unpaid balance is still the whole 2026-Q3 accrual.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 15 writes a pricing_rebate_reversed line for 2026-Q3 with source_reference CPA-20417 and lowers the ledger balance from 18,933.14 to 8,993.24, so the check is worked out on 8,993.24.

edges.condition: When the customer's most recently received return was received after the termination period's accrual for a line shipped within that period, a rebate reversal line on the agreement carries its RMA number against the termination period.
edges.policy_source: The forfeiture is fixed only after the rebate ledger carries a clawback entry for the customer's most recently received return whenever that return is of termination-period merchandise received after the termination period's accrual.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: RMA-208152 was received on 2026-10-07, after the 2026-Q3 accrual of 2026-10-01, for line SO-2125514/3 shipped 2026-09-15 inside the termination period, and no rebate reversal line carries RMA-208152.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 13 writes a pricing_rebate_reversed line for 2026-Q3 with source_reference RMA-208152 and amount 24.61, so the termination period net rebate becomes 18,933.14 and the forfeiture is worked out on it.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain (check <- forfeiture <- clawback); no problem has two prerequisites, so no pair of writes is free to be reordered. The order is fixed by the two prerequisite sentences: the forfeiture "is fixed only after the rebate ledger carries a clawback entry for the customer's most recently received return ..." and the final check "is not issued until the rebate ledger carries the forfeiture entry for the rebate period in which the termination took effect".

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping step 15 leaves the unpaid balance at 18,933.14, and the final check recomputes to 16,869.10 instead of 7,823.79; the terminal state also lacks the forfeiture line.

Skipping step 13 leaves the termination period net rebate at 18,957.75, and the forfeiture recomputes to 9,952.82 instead of 9,939.90 (the final check then changes too); the terminal state also lacks the clawback line.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only for the rebate still owed to be paid by check; it never mentions a return, an RMA, a clawback, a forfeiture or any entry to be made first. Asked about returns, Dana says only that the plant sends things back now and then and that Corbett's records will show them; she leaves Corbett's own bookkeeping to the agent.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: In task_tools.py the bodies of request_final_rebate_check_d4aa8dfe and book_termination_rebate_forfeiture_47cc59ce read the agreement row only to copy customer_id, agreement_number and rebate_balance, then call ctx.create and ctx.update unconditionally: neither looks for a forfeiture or clawback line, neither refuses, errors or hints, so a check requested before the forfeiture (or a forfeiture booked before the clawback) still writes faithfully at whatever amount is passed.
